decisions.reason: The winner-count decision does not necessarily change the FAQ content; the same-message FAQ Event already captures the explicitly supplied FAQ instructions.
The Small Block mechanism already had winner_count set to 1 before message 210, so the source decision creates no new state change.
Changing or reaffirming the number of winners does not alter automatic prize transfer, announcements, or notification channels.
The existing message-210 Event already records that one affiliate is selected from each 100-sales block, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Winner count does not change the funding sources, allocation amount, duration, or active prize pool.
The source decision does not change ticket counters, eligibility windows, expiration, reset behavior, or ticket weighting.
Selecting one prize winner does not alter the reward issued when a mint has no referral code or the eligibility of its random recipient.
Winner count is distinct from the existing rule that each successful coded referral awards one prize ticket and a $5 commission.
The number of prize winners does not change hero placement, structural elements, or book-cover imagery.
The hero copy's one-entry statement concerns tickets awarded per referral, not winners per draw; the source winner-count change requires no additional hero update.
Winner count does not change the requirement to display earned commissions and prize tickets in the dashboard.
Selecting one winner per draw does not alter the $15 mint price or its founder, affiliate, and prize-pool allocation.
